rationale: Voltage drops below 0.9 pu at 40ms (0.86 pu) and returns to normal (0.91 pu) at 120ms. The non-normal interval spans from 40ms to 100ms inclusive. All voltage values in this range are between 0.1 and 0.9 pu, classifying as a voltage sag. Duration is calculated as end_timestamp - start_timestamp + sample_interval = 100 - 40 + 20 = 80ms = 0.08s. Minimum voltage is 0.58 pu at 80ms, and maximum current is 1.44 pu at 80ms.
